gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.007033 40.745807)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 140 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.007033, 40.745807), 4326)::geography AS geometry
),
raster_points AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, ST_Buffer(p.geometry::geometry, 0.001)))).geom AS geom
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    poi_geom p
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
    AND (ST_Value(r.rast, 1, (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, ST_Buffer(p.geometry::geometry, 0.001)))).path)) < 140
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT
    geom
  FROM
    raster_points
  ORDER BY
    geom <-> (SELECT geometry FROM poi_geom)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ST_Distance(
    (SELECT geometry FROM poi_geom),
    (SELECT geom FROM nearest_point)
  ) AS distance_meters;
